newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila stocks regress at close after thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Manila stocks regress at close after thin trade.

text.p: Manila shares finished lower for the third consecutive session on Thursday as selected second-and third-liner stocks continued to command attention away from blue chips, traders said.
"Overall, market sentiment is weak. It is mirroring the Dow Jones performance and the slight pullback of PLDT helped to weigh down the index," said Felix Barrientos, dealer at ING Baring.
The main index closed 9.40 points lower at 3,261.24.
The Dow Jones posted an overnight decline of 45.79 points to 7,039.37 with PLDT's American Depositary Receipt shedding $0.25 to $60.625.
Losers outpaced gainers 62 to 57 in the broad market with the commercial-industrial and property sub-indices ending lower while all others rose.

Traders said the end to the Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) internal problems may boost the market in coming days. The bourse has been roiled by a wave of resignations including that of PSE president Vitaliano Nanagas. Its board will meet to discuss a replacement for Nanagas.
